test_setitem_column_with_dtype: test setting a DataFrame column with a specific numpy dtype like int64 or float32
test_setitem_multiple_columns_from_array: test setting multiple DataFrame columns simultaneously from a 2D numpy array
test_setitem_extension_types: test setting DataFrame columns with extension array types like Period, Interval, and DatetimeTZ
test_setitem_boolean_mask: test setting DataFrame values using a boolean mask indexer across all columns
test_setitem_copy_view_semantics: test that DataFrame setitem operations maintain correct copy and view semantics
